name: mva-prelit
description: Motor vehicle accident (MVA) pre-litigation workflow: intake-to-demand tasks plus Georgia statutory deadlines (SOL, ante litem) with stacked reminders.

date_inputs.label: Matter open / intake date (task offsets count from here)
Date of injury (drives PI SOL and ante litem)
Date of property loss (drives PD SOL)

deadlines.label: Ante Litem Notice — State of Georgia

tasks.name: Log lead in Clio and capture lead source
Complete screening interview and record accident facts, parties, and insurance
Run conflict check against all parties
Attorney go/no-go decision on viability
Send and execute contingency fee / retainer agreement
Obtain signed HIPAA authorizations and record releases
Advise client: no contact with at-fault adjuster, no social media posts
Open matter in Clio with client, parties, insurance, and MVA type
Assign case manager and supervising attorney of record
GOVERNMENT PARTY — ante litem required; escalate to supervising attorney TODAY
Build standard Clio folder structure (correspondence, medical, insurance, evidence, liens, settlement)
Send Letters of Representation to client's carrier and at-fault carrier
Open claims; record claim numbers and adjuster contacts in Clio
Request at-fault policy limits and client coverages (UM/UIM, MedPay, PIP)
Order police/accident report and crash photos from investigating agency
Photograph client's vehicle damage, scene, and visible injuries
Identify and obtain witness statements while memories are fresh
COMMERCIAL TRUCK — send spoliation / evidence-preservation letter (ELD, telematics, dashcam, DQ file) and notify attorney
Coordinate property damage claim, appraisal/total-loss valuation, and rental (separate track)
Confirm client is treating and following provider instructions
Set up provider / date-of-service / diagnosis tracking in Clio
Coordinate MedPay / PIP / health insurance and anticipate liens early
First monthly client check-in (repeat monthly until MMI)
Monitor treatment for gaps; document and flag to attorney
Confirm client reaches MMI or is released from care (triggers Phase 4)
Request all medical records and itemized bills from every provider (HIPAA)
Request wage-loss documentation if lost income is claimed
Identify every lien and reimbursement interest (health/ERISA, hospital, Medicare/Medicaid, MedPay)
Calculate total special damages (medical + wage loss + out-of-pocket)
Assemble demand package (liability summary, medical narrative, records, bills, wage loss, photos)
Draft case valuation for attorney review
SERIOUS/TRUCKING — prepare time-limited demand under O.C.G.A. § 9-11-67.1 with attorney-approved terms
Supervising attorney reviews and approves demand (no demand goes out without sign-off)
Send approved demand and calendar the response deadline in Clio
Track demand deadline and adjuster response; follow up promptly
Document every offer/counter; obtain written client authority before countering or accepting
Attorney reviews release before client signs
Negotiate and resolve all liens; obtain final reduced payoffs in writing
Prepare settlement statement / disbursement sheet for attorney approval
Review disbursement with client, obtain signature, and disburse funds/liens/costs/fee
